current_remote_head_verified_externally_: Also self-referential for the same reason, one level further out: the LAST commit of this round (after this artifact, the artifact-SHA patch, and submission rebuild are all committed and pushed) cannot contain its own hash either, and no later commit exists in this round to patch it into. This is NOT left unexplained: the literal final remote HEAD SHA is stated in this round's closing chat report and is independently, externally verifiable at any time via `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/offline/nova-competition-agent-optimization` -- the branch this round pushes to and nowhere else. This field (renamed from v4's 'final_remote_sha') exists specifically so a reader never confuses 'the SHA this JSON file itself was committed at' with 'the SHA the branch ultimately ended up at after every commit in this round' -- they are two different, both legitimately-null-at-write-time values, and conflating them was a real ambiguity risk this rename closes.

submission.standalone_full_loop_note: NEW this round: scripts/verify_submission_standalone_full_loop.py copies submission/ to an isolated temp directory and runs `python run.py` as a real subprocess with PYTHONPATH explicitly cleared (env={'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin'}) and only a minimal environment, feeding a scripted multi-turn JSON-lines conversation until DIAGNOSE. Verified the FULL observation -> routing -> retrieval -> differential -> ASK/EXAM/TEST -> update -> DIAGNOSE loop standalone: 20 turns (10 ASK, 6 EXAM, 4 TEST) ending in a correct DIAGNOSE (Acute Coronary Syndrome, for a classic crushing-chest-pain-radiating-to-left-arm presentation), clean process exit code 0, under the default mock provider. Also verified graceful real-LLM-unavailable handling under NOVA_LLM_PROVIDER=competition (no live gpt-oss-20b endpoint reachable in this sandbox, connection refused): the agent correctly retries per-turn, falls back to deterministic reasoning, and then correctly REFUSES to let the case reach DIAGNOSE with zero real-LLM successes (a hard, pre-existing safety gate, unmodified this round) -- clean controlled exit code 1 with an explicit FATAL message, never a crash, hang, or silently-substituted diagnosis.

generalization_hardening_this_round.summary: Audited (never tuned directly against) Blind v13's own critical-recall drop at an abstract architectural-failure-category level and fixed four root-cause defect classes generically.
fixes: chief_complaint.py: systematic Tier-1 typical_features coverage audit (scripts/audit_chief_complaint_coverage.py) closed 11 genuine presenting-complaint gaps via 7 new routing domains (upper_respiratory, diarrhea, numbness, vision_changes, neck_stiffness, hemoptysis, seizure), each wired into the relevant disease's own chief_complaint_tags

chief_complaint.py: SPECIFICITY_PRECEDENCE mechanism -- a specific concept (focal_weakness/aphasia/numbness, syncope, gi_bleeding, hemoptysis) now outranks its generic umbrella tag (weakness, dizziness, abdominal_pain, cough) as primary when real specific evidence exists, applied once in the shared _scores() primitive so both single-tag routing and multi-concept extraction benefit identically

matching.py: replaced the naive first-6-characters truncation stemmer with a conservative, deterministic suffix-stripping normalizer covering all 7 explicitly required morphological pairs, falling back to truncation only for irregular pairs (exertional/exertion)

candidate_generator.py/differential.py/stop_policy.py/safety_validator.py: zero-evidence fallback file-order bug -- the whole-catalog fallback is now tagged 'zero_evidence_fallback', differential.py marks every item fallback_candidate=True, both DIAGNOSE gates (deterministic stop policy and the LLM-selected-diagnosis validator) refuse to diagnose confidently in this state, action_selector.py prefers clarifying ASK/EXAM over a blind TEST

differential.py: confirmatory_findings now scored against a new PatientState.objective_findings_text() (EXAM/TEST/imaging results only), never past_medical_history/social_history -- closes a real false positive where a patient's merely-reported PAST diagnosis (e.g. 'atrial fibrillation' in PMH) spuriously satisfied a confirmatory finding that requires an actual current test (e.g. 'atrial fibrillation on ecg') to have been performed

two self-caught false-positive fuzzy-matching regressions from the taxonomy/precedence work itself, both fixed with generic guards: hemoptysis's alias phrasing narrowed to strictly 2-content-word blood-anchored phrases, syncope's 'everything went dark' narrowed to 'went dark', and a >=2-overlapping-word requirement added to the specificity-precedence promotion path itself
generalization_hardening_this_round.regression_status: No regression: full pytest 596/1 (up from 520/1), tuning/held-out/generalization-v2/stress/dev-round-d ALL 100% scored accuracy / 0% critical miss (generalization-v2 and stress were unchanged at 100%/0%; dev-round-d is a new set, also 100%/0%), retrieval recall floor unchanged (56.8/61.4/61.4 and 75.0/93.2/93.2), new routing benchmark 100% across all 6 metrics, adversarial all PASS, leakage scan clean, disease-coverage audit clean.
